dt-option.name: stateRestore.bookmark.match

type.description:
This value can be one of the following:
* `-string id` (default) - bookmarked state is found based on its ID and the source value found * `-string name` - bookmarked state is found based on the name of the states.

dt-option.description:
When a value is found by `-init stateRestore.bookmark.src`, it can be configured to match against either a state id, or a state name - this configuration option controls which.
Using an id is generally preferred as it cannot change once created, unlike a state name, which can (if operating on an end user defined state, not a predefined one). If the state name changes, then any existing bookmarks pointing to it will no longer load, unlike when an id is used.
However, using a name can sometimes be desirable as it provides more context in the URL, allowing the end user to more easily identify a state. It is recommended that you only use name based bookmarking in StateRestore with `-init stateRestore.predefined` states, and disallow the end user from creating their own states.

example.title: Find a state based on the state's name and the value of the `dtsr` query parameter
